# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# SPEC: dry-run mode for exif-tagger
# Generated by: project-lead agent  
# Date: 2024-07-14
# Priority: medium (nice-to-have, no breaking changes)
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

module_name: main.py + cli argument extension
version: 1
priority: medium

summary: |
  Lägg till --dry-run CLI-flagga som gör att exif-tagger skuggar (simulate) 
  EXIF-skrivningen istället för att faktiskt skriva till bilderna. Resultatet 
  visas i sammanfattningen men inga filer ändras.

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# RESPONSIBILITY & BOUNDARIES  
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
responsibility: |
  Hantera dry-run-logik i main.py:
    - Parsa --dry-run flaggan från CLI-argumenten
    - Delegatera till exif_writer.tag_image_exif med ett flaggat läge
    - Skugga skrivning (skriv INTE till filer) men ändå beräkna vad som skulle skrivas
    
not_responsible_for:
  - Implementering av dry-run-logiken i exif_writer (den har redan dedup/append logik)  
  - Nya tests för AI-modellens respons-parsing

dependencies:
  - module_name: main.py
    import_type: from
    usage: Add --dry-run argument to argparse parser
    
  - module_name: exif_writer.py  
    import_type: from
    usage: tag_image_exif receives dry_run=True, skips actual file write but returns the same tuple

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PUBLIC API CONTRACT
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
public_api:
  - function_name: main (in main.py)
    signature: |
      def run(
          config_path: str,
          verbose: bool = False,
          force_resume: bool = False,
          dry_run: bool = False,  # NEW PARAMETER
      ) -> int:
        """Execute full tagging pipeline with optional dry-run mode."""
    parameters:
      dry_run:
        type: bool
        description: "If True, simulate EXIF writes without modifying image files"
        required: false
        default_value: False

  - function_name: tag_image_exif (in exif_writer.py) – signature extension
    signature: |
      def tag_image_exif(
          image_path: Path,
          matched_tag_names: list[str],
          dry_run: bool = False,  # NEW PARAMETER  
      ) -> tuple[bool, int]:
        """Convenience wrapper. If dry_run=True, skip actual file write."""
    returns:
      type: tuple[bool, int]
      description: |
        (was_modified, new_tags_written) – same contract, but was_modified=False 
        when dry_run=True even if tags would have been added

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# ERROR HANDLING CONTRACT  
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
error_handling:
  strategy: fail-fast
  
  cases:
    - scenario: "Dry-run with corrupt image file"
      action: Skip the image, log warning, continue to next image
      logging_level: WARNING

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# DATA FLOW  
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
data_flow:
  inputs:
    - source_module: CLI (argparse)
      type: bool (dry_run flag)
      
  outputs:
    - destination: stdout (via summary output)
      description: |
        I sammanfattningen visar dry-run-läget:
          "Would have tagged X images with Y new tags total"
        Istället för: 
          "Successfully tagged X images with Y new tags total"

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# IMPLEMENTATION CONSTRAINTS (NON-NEGOTIABLE)  
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
constraints:
  - "dry_run-flaggan ska delegateras till exif_writer.tag_image_exif som parameter"
  - "Inga andra filer ändras i dry-run-läget – inga checkpoint-uppdateringar heller!"
  - "Sammanfattningen måste tydligt markera att det var en simulering"

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# TEST STRATEGY  
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
test_strategy:
  unit_tests:
    - name: test_dry_run_flag_default_false
      setup: |
        Call run(config_path, verbose=False) without dry_run argument
      
      input: Standard config with valid images and tags
      expected_output: "assert default dry_run parameter is False"
      
    - name: test_dry_run_no_file_modification  
      setup: |
        Capture modification time of image files before and after run() in dry-run mode
      input: Image file path that would normally be tagged
      expected_output: |
        assert image_mtime_before == mtime_after  # No modification!
        assert no_checkpoint_update_occurred
      
    - name: test_dry_run_summary_marked_simulation
      setup: |
        Capture stdout during dry-run execution
      input: Valid config with tags and images
      expected_output: "Summary text contains 'Would have tagged' not 'Successfully tagged'"

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# EDGE CASES  
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
edge_cases:
  - scenario: "Dry-run with existing checkpoint"
    expected_behavior: Do NOT update the checkpoint file – we haven't actually processed anything
  
  - scenario: "Dry-run on image with no matching tags"
    expected_behavior: Log debug message, continue processing next image

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# REVIEW CHECKLIST  
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
review_checklist:
  - [ ] run() function accepts dry_run parameter (default False)
  - [ ] tag_image_exif() signature extended with dry_run=False  
  - [ ] No checkpoint file is written when dry_run=True
  - [ ] Summary text distinguishes "Would have tagged" from actual modifications
  - [ ] Unit tests verify no file modification occurs in dry-run mode
